assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setback, building control line, road redline), ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for the submitted provisional boundaries and design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (geometry_role=provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false). They may be used for AI generation, visualization, and intake self-check only, and must not be treated as official redline, approval basis, or precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are supplied. The organizer data gap does not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, parcel/ownership boundaries, heritage control zones, road redlines, municipal pipelines, and public-service inventories are not yet available from cleared public sources.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish conclusions, traffic and municipal findings, and heritage controls remain method frameworks and pending-confirmation items, not statutory conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Green ratio, public-space ratio, road ratio, building density, and land-use shares are design suggestions recomputed from the submitted geometry in EPSG:4548.
assumptions.impact: These values are not official planning controls and must be reconciled with official regulatory conditions when available.

assumptions.statement: Annual events, developer-community operations, scenario opening, pilgrimage landmarks, and conversion pathways are concept suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: They are not confirmed government decisions, investment commitments, or implementation arrangements.

assumptions.statement: All figures, drawings, icons, data, and code assets are generated for this submission; any third-party brand, font, image, portrait, or trademark requires clearance before use.
assumptions.impact: The HTML report and visualization remain offline and reference only local assets.
